brand.$description: The brand surface: the surface that follows the brand, such as the Arizona Header's fill. Blue by default; a theme can point it at another primary color, such as Red for the original red header. Repoint on-brand.* with it — aliases the brand palette.

default.$description: Text and icons on surface.brand. Repoint it whenever a theme repoints surface.brand — aliases the brand palette.

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus ring on surface.brand. Repoint it whenever a theme repoints surface.brand — aliases the brand palette.

logo.$description: Logo color on surface.brand, such as the Arizona Header's wordmark. Separate from on-brand.default because a logo's color is its own brand decision: it can't follow every change to text color. Repoint it whenever a theme repoints surface.brand — aliases the brand palette.

ease-in-out.$description: CSS ease-in-out: starts and ends slowly.

height.$description: Header height: its minimum height at every screen size, and its fixed height below 992px.

color.$description: Header fill: the brand surface, Blue by default. The original red header comes from a theme that points surface.brand at Red.
Color of the header's wordmark logo.

width.$description: Wordmark width below the sm breakpoint (576px).

height.$description: Wordmark height below the sm breakpoint (576px).

width.$description: Wordmark width from the sm breakpoint (576px) up.

height.$description: Wordmark height from the sm breakpoint (576px) up.

margin-left.$description: Space before the wordmark, at the header's left edge.

color.$description: Keyboard focus ring on the logo and header buttons, drawn inside the element's edge.

width.$description: Width of the inset keyboard focus ring on the logo and header buttons.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the logo and header buttons while they have keyboard focus, so the ring has rounded corners.

color.$description: Header button text and icon color.

size.$description: Header button icon width and height: the icon is 24px square, whether it's an SVG, a sprite or a font glyph.

color.$description: Header button icon color: the same as the label, so icons and text change together. An SVG icon picks it up through fill="currentColor".

gap.$description: Space between a header button's icon and its label.

y.$description: Header button top and bottom padding.

min-height.$description: Header button minimum height: the header's own height.

duration.$description: How long a header button's colors and focus ring take to change. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

easing.$description: Easing for a header button's color and focus ring changes. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

scroll-offset.$description: When the header is fixed on mobile (below 992px): how far below the top of the screen linked sections stop when scrolled to, so the header doesn't cover them.

duration.$description: How long the off-canvas panel (opened by the header buttons) takes to slide in or out. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

easing.$description: Easing for the off-canvas panel's slide. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

duration.$description: How long the backdrop behind the off-canvas panel takes to fade in or out. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

easing.$description: Easing for the off-canvas backdrop's fade. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.
